id: title:Gilbert09:stop retrying a redirect loop in the shared rest client

review.posthog_relevance: Changes request handling behavior for redirect loops in the REST client, preventing unnecessary retries and potential resource exhaustion.
review.reason: Adds exception handling and marker support for TooManyRedirects, changing failure behavior from retry to immediate failure. This is a substantive, bounded correctness improvement.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies on supplied observations; actual implementation and marker definitions are absent from this chunk, though the behavior change and its relevance are demonstrated.
